snippet.title: FolkOrigin - RTS game - early access 0.5.66
snippet.description:
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/28...
TWITTER:   / ldsg8827  
INSTAGRAM:   / ldsg8827  

FolkOrigin is an RTS game set on a 2D hexagonal map. The main goal is to create a settlement to produce and extract as many raw materials as possible on the map. If you plan your workforce well, you will obtain a lot of raw materials needed for trade, thanks to which our settlement becomes rich and units can produce items that strengthen their individual characteristics. A well-trained and equipped unit is the key to defending the settlement and fighting Slavic monsters.

I work on the game together with my younger brother who creates all 2D assets such as landscapes, characters, buildings, etc. I take care of everything else - coding C#, testing, writing all the content in the game, publications, trailer, etc. Work on the project has started in September 2023.
Generally, we are working on a game that we dream about and that we want to play ourselves :)

• 29 buildings to build
• 24 raw materials
• 52 different items in your inventory
• 28 enemy units
• 24 units for recruitment
• mode: [b]tutorial[/b] - tutorial mode is a game mode in which the player is introduced step by step to the basic mechanics related to the development of the settlement. [b]The tutorial is under constant development[/b].
• mode: [b]free play[/b] - free mode is a game in which the player sets victory conditions, develops his settlement, recruits selected units and modifies their skills in any way.

• adding/improving animations and appearances of character buildings * -[b] in progress[/b]
• diversity of landscape * -[b] in progress[/b]
• amulets that increase stats * -[b] in progress[/b]
• runes granting special skills **
• Steam achievements**
• ability to recruit exotic units**
• improving the layout of UI panels and buttons ** -[b] in progress[/b]
• development of tooltip content ** -[b] in progress[/b]
• summary of the completed game ** -[b] in progress[/b]
• BALANCE of valuation of raw materials / items / units ** -[b] in progress[/b]
• crafting - producing items *** -[b] in progress[/b]
• ambient, sfx *** -[b] in progress[/b]
• individual skills of units *** -[b] in progress[/b]
• gameplay recording system *** -[b] in progress[/b]
• weapons production ***
• building defensive structures ***
• game mode: hunting ****
• game mode: survival ****
• game mode: map domination - multiplayer *****!!!

 (* - level of difficulty of execution)

Audi 𝄞 - AlkaKrab
